To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a multi stage framework that trains a generalist followed by experts is an efficient and effective ensemble approach, (ii) the confusion graph is an important tool for identifying and characterizing the errors of a generalist, and (iii) a generalist can be trained efficiently by a simple algorithm, such as the one based on the perceptron learning algorithm, and experts can be trained by any of the available efficient learners.
